hero.headline: Every Night, Just Me.
hero.subheadline: A postpartum night-coordination system that replaces nightly arguing with a pre-agreed roster, a fairness ledger, and the exact words to make it stick.
hero.body: You are not asking for too much. You are asking for a system that means you do not have to ask at all. Every Night, Just Me gives you a written night-shift contract, a fairness ledger, and seven precision scripts - so the night has a clear owner, the handoffs have a phrase, and the argument stops before it starts.
hero.trust_line: Educational content. Not medical advice. Built for postpartum couples and solo mothers in the first 0-6 months.
hero.evidence_label: Educational content informed by relationship research, postpartum health guidance, and lived experience. It is not a substitute for medical, clinical, or mental-health assessment.

before_state.label: Sound familiar?
paragraphs: You are waking up every 90 minutes. Your partner is asleep. You have asked - once, twice, ten times - for help. He means well. He just doesn't have a system. And so every night gets renegotiated from scratch, at 3 AM, by two people running on near-zero.
By morning you are furious. By evening you are too tired to fight. By midnight you are up again - alone.
before_state.punch: This is not a parenting failure. It is a coordination failure. And coordination failures have a fix.

modules.label: What Every Night, Just Me gives you
modules.intro: 13 modules. One written system. Work through them in order, or jump straight to what tonight needs. Each module stands alone - together they form a contract your household actually follows.

items.title: Start Here - The 10-Step Roadmap
items.description: Know exactly where you are going before you begin.

items.title: The Argument That Ends the War
items.description: Understand why "can you help more" fails structurally - and what replaces it.

items.title: The Situation Finder
items.description: Three questions. Routes you to the exact roster and scripts built for your household.

items.title: The Decision Tree
items.description: Breastfeeding? Bottle? No partner? One diagram routes you to your system.

items.title: Roster Safety & Boundary Rules
items.description: The non-negotiable guardrails both adults agree to before signing the roster.

items.title: Three Roster Templates - A, B, and C
items.description: A: Breastfeeding-compatible split shift. B: Alternating full shift for bottle/expressed milk. C: Support-web roster for solo mothers or absent partners.

items.title: The Sleep Banker / Recovery Bank
items.description: A credit-and-debit system that makes invisible exhaustion visible - and redeemable - before it turns into resentment.

items.title: Seven Script Cards
items.description: The exact words for: initiating the conversation, defusing "I have work tomorrow," handling the baby-prefers-you excuse, the 2 AM emergency handoff, the Sunday review, the no-blame reset, and extended family criticism.

items.title: The Fridge Shift Chart
items.description: One page. Both adults see it every night. No app, no memory, no argument.

items.title: The 14-Day Shift Tracker
items.description: Track sleep opportunity blocks, partner initiative, handoff friction, and exhaustion - so you have evidence, not just feelings.

items.title: The Rescue Card - Bad Night Protocol
items.description: What to do when the baby is sick, teething, or the roster collapses. Includes a pocket-sized print version.

items.title: The Re-entry Protocol
items.description: Slid back to the old pattern? Three steps to restart without guilt, blame, or starting over from scratch.

items.title: Safety Gate - When Exhaustion Needs More Than a Night Plan
items.description: A clear checklist that separates ordinary exhaustion from something that needs professional support - with verified crisis numbers for Nigeria, the UK, and North America.

before_after.label: What changes
before_items: Arguments about whose turn it is
No way back when the system breaks
after_items: A pre-agreed roster - nobody has to ask
A named, non-optional shift with a clear start time
A fairness ledger that makes credits visible and time-bound
Seven scripts built for the exact conversation
A re-entry protocol designed to restart without blame

for_items: You are 0-6 months postpartum and doing the majority - or all - of the night care alone.
You are breastfeeding, bottle-feeding, or combination feeding, and your partner is home but not consistently contributing to nights.
You have asked for help before and gotten a one-off gesture, not a system.
You are a solo mother or have an absent partner - and you need to build a support web, not a couple's roster.
You are done arguing about whose turn it is and ready to replace the argument with a contract.
who_for.not_for_label: This is NOT for you if
not_for_items: You are looking for infant sleep training advice. This product coordinates adults - not babies.
You need clinical postpartum mental health support. If that is where you are, go directly to the Safety Gate - it routes you to verified crisis support for Nigeria, the UK, and North America.

promise.label: What we promise - and what we don't
promise.we_do: We promise you a system. A written roster. A fairness ledger. Precision scripts. A rescue plan. A re-entry route.
promise.we_do_not: We do not promise you a specific number of hours of sleep. We cannot control your baby's needs, your partner's cooperation, or your household's reality. What we can do is remove the structural reasons nights fail - the asking, the negotiating, the invisible debt - and replace them with a default that works even when you are too exhausted to be generous.
promise.evidence_label: Educational content informed by relationship research, postpartum health guidance, and lived experience. It is not a substitute for medical, clinical, or mental-health assessment.
